content: 1. Didanosine and metronidazole may increase each other's toxicity through pharmacodynamic synergism. This interaction carries a minor or unknown significance but may enhance the risk of peripheral neuropathy. 2. Metronidazole can increase the levels or effects of disopyramide by altering hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 3. Similarly, metronidazole can also elevate the levels or effects of estradiol vaginal through the same mechanism. The clinical significance of these interactions is minor or unknown. 12. Similarly, metronidazole may elevate the levels or effects of acalabrutinib through the same mechanism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended.
